import {cva} from 'class-variance-authority'

/**
 * Split from `button.tsx` because that module carries `'use client'` for the
 * `animation` prop's hooks, and a directive makes every export of a module a
 * client reference -- including a pure `cva` call. Server components (a
 * `<Link>` styled to look like a button, for instance) need to call this
 * function directly, which only works from a module with no directive at all.
 *
 * The press depth is read from `--press-scale`, which `pressStyle` sets from
 * the chosen preset. The fallback keeps a bare `buttonVariants()` pressable on
 * its own, for anyone who wants the look without importing the motion layer.
 *
 * The reduced-motion overrides are `!important` because they have to beat an
 * inline style, and nothing less does. `Button` already collapses its preset
 * through a hook, but a server-rendered `<Link>` cannot run one, so without
 * these it would keep pressing at full depth for a reader who asked the whole
 * system to stop moving.
 */
export const buttonVariants = cva(
  'inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium will-change-transform active:scale-[var(--press-scale,0.96)] motion-reduce:transition-none! motion-reduce:active:scale-100! focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:active:scale-100 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0',
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow hover:bg-primary/90',
        destructive: 'bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground shadow-sm hover:bg-destructive/90',
        outline:
          'border border-input bg-background shadow-sm hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground',
        secondary: 'bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground shadow-sm hover:bg-secondary/80',
        ghost: 'hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground',
        link: 'text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline',
      },
      size: {
        sm: 'h-8 rounded-md px-3 text-xs',
        default: 'h-9 px-4 py-2',
        lg: 'h-10 rounded-md px-8',
        icon: 'size-9',
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {variant: 'default', size: 'default'},
  },
)
